definitions.explanation: A single non-moving image, as opposed to video or animation. Used in technical and media contexts to distinguish photographs or screenshots from moving images.

examples.japanese: {静止画|せいしが}を{撮影|さつえい}する。
このカメラは{動画|どうが}だけでなく{静止画|せいしが}も{撮|と}れる。
examples.english: This camera can take still images as well as video.

examples.japanese: {動画|どうが}から{好|す}きな{場面|ばめん}を{静止画|せいしが}として{保存|ほぞん}することができる。
examples.english: You can save your favorite scene from a video as a still image.

notes:
Composed of {静止|せいし} (stillness, standstill) and {画|が} (image, picture). The opposite concept is {動画|どうが} (moving image, video).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {静止画|せいしが}を{撮影|さつえい}する (to capture a still image)
- {静止画|せいしが}と{動画|どうが} (still images and video)
- {高解像度|こうかいぞうど}{静止画|せいしが} (high-resolution still image)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {静止画|せいしが}: still image (technical term, contrasts with video)
- {写真|しゃしん}: photograph (everyday term)
- {画像|がぞう}: image, picture (general digital context)
